plans.name: Conference Week
plans.desc: A travel week: flights and transfers around the programme, the talk slot protected, and recovery time booked on the last day.
plans.descZh: 出差周：航班与转场围绕会议议程安排，留出报告时段的保护时间，最后一天排上恢复时间。

plans.name: Deep Work Week
plans.desc: A research week built around two protected blocks a day, with reading, writing and admin kept in their own lanes.
plans.descZh: 以每天两个受保护的深度工作时段为核心的科研周，阅读、写作与事务各占自己的时段。

plans.name: Teaching Week
plans.desc: A term week where two lectures anchor everything else: preparation sits the day before, office hours and grading sit the day after.
plans.descZh: 以两门课为锚点的学期周：备课排在前一天，答疑与批改排在后一天。
